# Twenty-eight

The county fair ran four days and the third day it rained.{>>check: was
the fair in August or September that year?<<}

Ferrante judged the wine and gave the ribbon to a Basque from Angwin,
which cost him two friendships.{>>this is a good beat but it belongs in
the previous chapter<<}

She rode home in the bed of the truck with the ribbon-less bottles and
did not say a word the whole way.{>>too neat<<}
